scenarios.description: Monday is treated as a Calculation Day. A schedule marks Monday as included and does not mark any non-weekday as included.
Sunday is treated as a Calculation Day. The schedule includes Sunday even though it is not Monday through Friday.
Every weekday except Wednesday is treated as a Calculation Day, while Wednesday is excluded. The rule is tested as a universal statement over all days.

A day is labeled a Calculation Day only after a manager approves it, and the approval happens on the previous day. The scenario asks whether the label depends on who approved it or when the approval occurred.
